Common questions

Planning restaurant upholstery

Can restaurant seating be restored outside business hours?

Scheduling depends on the size and construction of the project. We discuss access, removal and timing so the work can be planned around operations where practical.

Can you match an existing restaurant colour or finish?

We can review existing colours and materials and discuss the closest practical match or a coordinated new finish.

Do you work on fixed booths and banquettes?

Yes, many fixed or built-in pieces can be assessed. Photos of the full booth, seams, base and access points help determine the best approach.

Can a larger group of chairs or stools be completed together?

Yes. Quantity, condition and timing are considered together so finishes can remain coordinated across the space.
